Class StorageLifecycleStore

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.common.database.StorageLifecycleStore
public final class StorageLifecycleStore extends Object
Bounded, fresh JDBC snapshots; lifecycle decisions must not use Hibernate's entity cache.
